anchors.code_excerpt:
definition charge equals
    money of (if amount <= threshold
      then amount * lowerRate
      else threshold * lowerRate + (amount - threshold) * upperRate)
anchors.quote: The charge is amount times lowerRate up to and including threshold. Above threshold it is threshold times lowerRate plus the excess times upperRate. All inputs are nonnegative exact quantities. Calculate without intermediate rounding, then round the total once to the nearest cent, with exact half-cent ties away from zero. Money is denominated in HKD.

assumptions: The host supplies complete, nonnegative exact decimal inputs as required by the source.
Amounts and the resulting money are interpreted as HKD; rates are dimensionless.
The single money conversion rounds the exact total to the nearest cent, with half-cent ties away from zero, as specified for the pinned syntax.
value.interpretation: Apply lowerRate to the amount through the inclusive threshold. Above it, apply lowerRate to the threshold and upperRate to the excess. Round only the final total.
